description: Melodic technical djent -- Periphery-style. Adds real lydian color (bright, uplifting #4) over djent's own group-3/euclid-kick/pedal mechanisms rather than djent's deliberately un-melodic root/5th vocab. Calibrated against a real user-supplied reference track: its measured A-major key (Krumhansl-Schmuckler estimate, audio_vocab.py) motivated the A-rooted tuning, and its bright/articulate spectral-centroid reading motivated lydian over plain major. First preset to actually adopt X.6d's major-family scales (added but unused until now).
